description: Renewal-notice module with intention-revealing names and named constants, except activeSubscriptions holds the cancelled subscriptions (filter keeps cancelledAt !== null): a name that signals the opposite of its value

hard.note: One inverted predicate inside a filter; every other identifier and constant is well named, so the name reads correctly unless the filter body is checked

_calibration.note: Single planted misleading name, the severity-anchor error case (const active = users.filter(u => !u.active)); one extra finding tolerated if the agent also names the downstream autoRenewingSubscriptions
